desktop.notes:
• Send to Library (right-click a photo, or Cull → Send to Library → selected / all ★ favourites / all keeps): copies the picture - your edited version when there is one (IMG_1234_edited.jpg) - into one Library folder (Settings → General; default Pictures\Library), with a .pnfo file next to it holding everything Cullect knows: camera data, decision, ★, AI summary and tags, subject box and point of interest, main colour, place, notes, your crop, and where its backups are. A library.json lists every photo. Studio, Wildframe and Wallpaper Studio read it (format: projects/AI/photo-info/PHOTO-INFO.md). Sending again refreshes the data and keeps what other apps added. The card is never changed.
• Analysed once, on any device: the card's hidden .cullect folder now also carries the analysis (analysis.json.gz: camera data, measurements, offline AI). Opening the card on another PC or the phone takes those results for every unchanged photo instead of reading and analysing it again. Written at most every few minutes during an analysis and when it ends (the card is not worn).
• Backups per photo: Backup & Verify now remembers which files it verified where. Photo info shows "2 backup drives · safe to delete from the card" (full checksums on two different drives); the folder message says how many photos are safe to delete. Cullect never deletes anything itself.
• Each photo has an id (name + size + capture time) in the card file and its .pnfo - the same photo on any drive.
• Safer card file: cullect.json is flushed to the card before it replaces the old one, and the last good copy is kept as cullect.json.bak (used if the main file is damaged).
• Shift+click selects a run, like Explorer: every photo in order from the first to the one you Shift+click (and Shift+arrows) - not a rectangle. Dragging a box from empty space still selects by rectangle.
